metric_notes.search_time_seconds: Solver-reported search time in seconds; A* excludes heuristic preprocessing.
metric_notes.preprocessing_time_seconds: A* H2 build time, recorded separately; the H2 cache is cleared before every run.
metric_notes.peak_memory_mb: Peak tracemalloc memory in decimal MB as reported by the solver.
metric_notes.expanded_nodes: Solver's expanded-state counter; goal state is not counted.
metric_notes.solution_length: Number of actions in the returned path; blank when no solution.
metric_notes.total_cost: Sum of Engine.step_cost along the returned path; blank when no solution.
